name: nocturne-e2e
description: Playwright E2E harness for nocturne (slot 8, PLAN Phase 7) — deterministic critical-path coverage for the GPU audio-reactive particle field. Headless chromium is software-GL (SwiftShader), so the suite NEVER asserts the live 60fps GPU field; it covers the things that ARE deterministic headless: the intro gesture gate (no autoplay), full HUD keyboard reachability + the WAI-ARIA preset radiogroup, the chrome theme (light/dark) with the canvas stage staying dark in both, the reduced-motion calm/still path, the Tier-4 / no-WebGL / no-JS poster + directory floor, mute store behaviour, the canvas a11y + aria-live text alternative, the SEO surface, and 320px no-overflow. Runs against a BUILT + SERVED app on :3100 (next build --webpack then next start, NOT next dev — the strict CSP forbids unsafe-eval). Point at any deployed URL via BASE_URL.
